property_summary: For any array of addresses where the external low-level calls to caddress succeed, the transfer function should complete without reverting and return true; the buggy version reverts when the array has exactly one address, even if all external calls would succeed, so it fails to meet the rule that a call with a non-empty array and successful externals always returns true.
change_summary: Replace require(_tos.length > 0) with require(_tos.length > 1) so calls with exactly one address revert instead of completing.
